package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"errors"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgconn"
)

// ProvisionDiagnosticBootstrapBinding serializes lookup and insert under a
// table lock. The migration's append-only trigger remains a second line of
// defense against any accidental mutable implementation.
func (s Store) ProvisionDiagnosticBootstrapBinding(ctx context.Context, wanted domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding) (domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding, bool, error) {
	wanted, err := domain.NormalizeDiagnosticBootstrapBinding(wanted)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding{}, false, err
	}
	tx, err := s.Pool.Begin(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding{}, false, err
	}
	defer tx.Rollback(ctx)
	// SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE conflicts with INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, so another
	// provisioner cannot add a newer binding between this lookup and insert.
	if _, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `LOCK TABLE diagnostic_bootstrap_binding IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE`); err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding{}, false, err
	}
	stored, err := latestDiagnosticBootstrapBinding(ctx, tx, wanted.GoalCode, wanted.DirectionCode)
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		stored, err = insertDiagnosticBootstrapBinding(ctx, tx, wanted)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding{}, false, err
		}
		if stored != wanted {
			return domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding{}, false, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if err := tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
			return domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding{}, false, err
		}
		return stored, true, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding{}, false, err
	}
	if stored != wanted {
		return domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	if err := tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding{}, false, err
	}
	return stored, false, nil
}

func latestDiagnosticBootstrapBinding(ctx context.Context, row pgx.Tx, goalCode, directionCode string) (domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding, error) {
	var binding domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding
	err := row.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT goal_code,direction_code,course_id::text,binding_revision,policy_version,binding_digest,active,created_at FROM diagnostic_bootstrap_binding WHERE goal_code=$1 AND direction_code=$2 ORDER BY binding_revision DESC LIMIT 1`, goalCode, directionCode).Scan(
		&binding.GoalCode, &binding.DirectionCode, &binding.CourseID, &binding.BindingRevision,
		&binding.PolicyVersion, &binding.BindingDigest, &binding.Active, &binding.CreatedAt,
	)
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding{}, err
	}
	return normalizeDiagnosticBootstrapBinding(binding)
}

func insertDiagnosticBootstrapBinding(ctx context.Context, row pgx.Tx, binding domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding) (domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding, error) {
	var stored domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding
	err := row.QueryRow(ctx, `INSERT INTO diagnostic_bootstrap_binding(goal_code,direction_code,binding_revision,course_id,policy_version,binding_digest,active,created_at) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8) RETURNING goal_code,direction_code,course_id::text,binding_revision,policy_version,binding_digest,active,created_at`, binding.GoalCode, binding.DirectionCode, binding.BindingRevision, binding.CourseID, binding.PolicyVersion, binding.BindingDigest, binding.Active, binding.CreatedAt).Scan(
		&stored.GoalCode, &stored.DirectionCode, &stored.CourseID, &stored.BindingRevision,
		&stored.PolicyVersion, &stored.BindingDigest, &stored.Active, &stored.CreatedAt,
	)
	if err != nil {
		var pgError *pgconn.PgError
		if errors.As(err, &pgError) && pgError.Code == "23505" {
			return domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding{}, domain.ErrConflict
		}
		return domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding{}, err
	}
	return normalizeDiagnosticBootstrapBinding(stored)
}

var _ repository.DiagnosticBootstrapBindingProvisioner = Store{}
